starting-the-quest.speaker: Bill Teach
starting-the-quest.text: What right have ye to be so happy, landlubber?

starting-the-quest.player: Well it is quite a nice day.

starting-the-quest.speaker: Bill Teach
starting-the-quest.text: Will ye forgive an old sailor his temper [lad/lass/kid]? I'm in dire straits indeed.

starting-the-quest.player: What's the problem? I may be able to help.

starting-the-quest.speaker: Bill Teach
starting-the-quest.text: I dunno, [lad/lass/kid], I need a pirate to help me with my problem, but none will sail with me.

starting-the-quest.speaker: Bill Teach
starting-the-quest.text: Well, ye look like ye might have the right stuff, tell me would ye like te be a pirate?

options.text: Yes, I've always wanted to be a pirate!

steps.player: Yes, I've always wanted to be a pirate!

steps.text: If the player does not have all quest requirements:

steps.speaker: Bill Teach
steps.text: It takes more grit than most have te be a pirate, and I don't think ye've got what it takes [lad/lass/kid].
You do not meet all of the requirements to start the Cabin Fever quest.

steps.speaker: Bill Teach
steps.text: Well [lad/lass/kid], I don't think ye could pirate yer way out of a chest full of piracy.

steps.player: Awww...

steps.speaker: Bill Teach
steps.text: But since nobody else will risk the trip ye'll do!

steps.speaker: Bill Teach
steps.text: Well [lad/lass/kid], I be Bill Teach, the Captain of the Adventurous, one of the finest ships ever to sail these waters.

steps.speaker: Bill Teach
steps.text: I'm in port doin' some legitimate tradin' before headin' back to Mos Le'Harmless.

steps.player: Mos Le'Harmless? Where is that?

steps.speaker: Bill Teach
steps.text: It's a pirate stronghold off the southern coast of Morytania. Been in existence for years it has and I reckon it's the best place for pirates to relax!

steps.speaker: Bill Teach
steps.text: Well, one of the best... A lot be liking the Pandemonium these days, and Brimhaven does have that fancy Agility Arena...

steps.player: Will it be OK for me to go there if I am not a pirate?

steps.speaker: Bill Teach
steps.text: Of course [lad/lass/kid], once we make landfall ye'll have worked as a sailor on a pirate vessel, which is one of the easiest ways to become a true pirate.
If the player has completed The Pandemonium:

steps.player: Worked as a sailor? Do I really need to do that? I've already got some sailing experience.

steps.speaker: Bill Teach
steps.text: Of course ye do, [lad/lass/kid]! Plenty be claiming they've got what it takes to be a pirate, but I can't be takin' ye word 'till I see it for myself.

steps.speaker: Bill Teach
steps.text: This brings me back to the reason I'm stuck here of course, and the reason I need your help.

steps.speaker: Bill Teach
steps.text: Last night I got into a war o' words with another Cap'n, and he has vowed to sink my ship and put all of my crew to the sword.

steps.player: How horrible! How did your crew react?

steps.speaker: Bill Teach
steps.text: By desertin'.

steps.player: All of them?

steps.speaker: Bill Teach
steps.text: Every last one!

steps.speaker: Bill Teach
steps.text: The second I leave port I'll come under attack. I think I'll be able te make it if I have another person helpin' out, but I wouldn't stand a chance by me self.

steps.speaker: Bill Teach
steps.text: Ye said ye would help me out [lad/lass/kid], will ye stand by yer word?

options.text: Yes, I am a man of my word.

steps.player: Yes, I am a [man/woman] of my word.

steps.speaker: Bill Teach
steps.text: Arr! Ye struck me as a [man/woman] of integrity!

steps.speaker: Bill Teach
steps.text: My ship is the Adventurous, and she's at the east dock.

steps.player: You won't...err...I mean ye'll not regret it Cap'n!

steps.speaker: Bill Teach
steps.text: I'm sure I won't.

options.text: No, if it's so dangerous your crew left, count me out.

steps.player: No, if it's so dangerous your crew left, count me out.

steps.speaker: Bill Teach
steps.text: Well, that doesn't surprise me much.

steps.speaker: Bill Teach
steps.text: On yer way [lad/lass/kid], leave me be.

options.text: No thanks, it sounds quite dangerous.

steps.player: No thanks, it sounds quite dangerous.

steps.speaker: Bill Teach
steps.text: Aye, that it be. Come back when yer liver ain't so lily-like, [lad/lass/kid].

starting-the-quest-trying-to-board-the-a.player: I don't think that whoever owns this ship will be happy with me wandering all over it.

speaking-to-bill-teach-again-at-the-pub.speaker: Bill Teach
speaking-to-bill-teach-again-at-the-pub.text: Let me finish my drink, landlubber!

speaking-to-bill-teach-again-at-the-pub.speaker: Bill Teach
speaking-to-bill-teach-again-at-the-pub.text: If ye ain't up te scratch as a pirate I may not get another one.

speaking-to-bill-teach-again-at-the-pub.speaker: Bill Teach
speaking-to-bill-teach-again-at-the-pub.text: Just remember, [he/she]'s all ye could get, Bill, and maybe ye'll get through it...

speaking-to-bill-teach-on-the-ship.speaker: Bill Teach
speaking-to-bill-teach-on-the-ship.text: Well, I had the feelin' ye might have run off when ye realised how much of a task ye had ahead of ye.

speaking-to-bill-teach-on-the-ship.player: Don't ye worry about me, Cap'n! I'm the scurviest, throat-cuttinest pirate to ever walk the mainplank! Arr!

speaking-to-bill-teach-on-the-ship.speaker: Bill Teach
speaking-to-bill-teach-on-the-ship.text: Aye, I should have remembered ye was eager.

steps.player: Let's go Cap'n!

options.text: Can I just go grab something?

steps.player: Can I just go grab something?

steps.speaker: Bill Teach
steps.text: Aye [lad/lass], take yer time, I'm not goin' anywhere without ye.

speaking-to-bill-teach-on-the-ship-talki.speaker: Bill Teach
speaking-to-bill-teach-on-the-ship-talki.text: Ye all ready to go lad?

options.text: Can I just go grab something?

cutscene-on-the-ship.player: Well, it looks like they've found us Cap'n.

cutscene-on-the-ship.speaker: Bill Teach
cutscene-on-the-ship.text: Well, without anyone else te help ye'll have te do some hard work if we don't want to end up walkin' home on the sea bed.

cutscene-on-the-ship.speaker: Bill Teach
cutscene-on-the-ship.text: Well if their first shot hadn't taken out the cannon I'd be firing that at them.

cutscene-on-the-ship.speaker: Bill Teach
cutscene-on-the-ship.text: Arr! They seek te hole the ship! Go and take care of their cannon.

cutscene-on-the-ship.speaker: Bill Teach
cutscene-on-the-ship.text: If ye grab some fuse from the gun locker, and a rope from the repair locker, then ye can use the rope on the sails to swing over and deal with their cannon.

cutscene-on-the-ship.speaker: Bill Teach
cutscene-on-the-ship.text: Just take the fuse, use it on the barrel of gunpowder next to the cannon, and then light it with something.

cutscene-on-the-ship.speaker: Bill Teach
cutscene-on-the-ship.text: A lantern, a tinderbox, it doesn't matter.

cutscene-on-the-ship.speaker: Bill Teach
cutscene-on-the-ship.text: They have masts as well don't they?

cutscene-on-the-ship.speaker: Bill Teach
cutscene-on-the-ship.text: Just do the same trick using some rope on their sails and swing over.

cutscene-on-the-ship.player: Arr! I'll hop to it Cap'n!

cutscene-on-the-ship.speaker: Bill Teach
cutscene-on-the-ship.text: Ye ain't a pirate yet by a long shot!

cutscene-on-the-ship.speaker: Bill Teach
cutscene-on-the-ship.text: I'll be on deck if ye need me.

cutscene-on-the-ship.player: Now to take care of that cannon!

cutscene-on-the-ship-teleporting-out-of-.text: It will probably not take Bill long to notice you have left the battle.
He will no doubt return to Phasmatys and wait for you to come back.

dealing-with-the-cannon-trying-to-fill-t.text: Urgent as this looks, if I haven't taken out that cannon they will just hole the ship again.

dealing-with-the-cannon-talking-to-bill-.player: Just to clear everything up, what is it you want me to do?

dealing-with-the-cannon-talking-to-bill-.speaker: Bill Teach
dealing-with-the-cannon-talking-to-bill-.text: Well, ye'll need to silence their cannon before it sinks us. Before ye do that though, ye'll need to swing over to their ship.

options.text: How do I make a rope swing?

steps.player: How do I make a rope swing?

steps.speaker: Bill Teach
steps.text: Yer not much of a pirate are ye lad?

steps.speaker: Bill Teach
steps.text: Ye climb up the mast and use a rope on the sails up there.

steps.speaker: Bill Teach
steps.text: Then ye climb down and ye swing on the rope.

steps.speaker: Bill Teach
steps.text: If I have te explain how ye do THAT then I might as well just send out some biscuit weevles to do the job instead.

steps.player: Aye aye Cap'n! One rope swing coming right up!

steps.speaker: Bill Teach
steps.text: Egad...

options.text: How can I blow up their cannon?

steps.player: How can I blow up their cannon?

steps.speaker: Bill Teach
steps.text: Well, ye'll need some fuse from the cannon locker below decks.

steps.speaker: Bill Teach
steps.text: Swing over to the enemy ship and put the fuse in the barrel of gunpowder they'll have next to the cannon to speed up their firin'.

steps.speaker: Bill Teach
steps.text: Then, use something on the fuse te get it lit.  A tinderbox, candle or any sort of flame will do.

steps.speaker: Bill Teach
steps.text: After that ye just step back and let it burn by its self.

steps.player: Arr! I'll blow that cannon sky high, sez I!

steps.speaker: Bill Teach
steps.text: Give me strength...

dealing-with-the-cannon-choosing-the-ret.player: Err, Cap'n, can we go back to port?

dealing-with-the-cannon-choosing-the-ret.speaker: Bill Teach
dealing-with-the-cannon-choosing-the-ret.text: Got a little scared now have we?

dealing-with-the-cannon-choosing-the-ret.player: It's not that, I just need to grab something from the bank, that's all...

dealing-with-the-cannon-choosing-the-ret.speaker: Bill Teach
dealing-with-the-cannon-choosing-the-ret.text: Are ye sure ye can't get by without it?

options.text: No, I need to go back now.

steps.player: No, I need to go back now.

steps.speaker: Bill Teach
steps.text: I thought as much.
(The screen fades to black. The player returns to Port Phasmatys.)
You return to port.

steps.player: I'll try...

steps.speaker: Bill Teach
steps.text: That's the spirit!

dealing-with-the-cannon-talking-to-bill-.speaker: Bill Teach
dealing-with-the-cannon-talking-to-bill-.text: Well, as much as this is an interestin' break, why don't ye head back to the ship and we'll see if we can beat them this time?

dealing-with-the-cannon-talking-to-bill-.speaker: Bill Teach
dealing-with-the-cannon-talking-to-bill-.text: All right, lad let's try this again. This time, try not te run away!

dealing-with-the-cannon-talking-to-bill-.speaker: Bill Teach
dealing-with-the-cannon-talking-to-bill-.text: Ye all ready to go lad?

options.text: Can I just go grab something?

dealing-with-the-cannon-the-enemy-reappe.speaker: Bill Teach
dealing-with-the-cannon-the-enemy-reappe.text: One look at the enemy and ye run away.

dealing-with-the-cannon-the-enemy-reappe.speaker: Bill Teach
dealing-with-the-cannon-the-enemy-reappe.text: Get over there and take out their cannon before I throw ye there me self.

dealing-with-the-cannon-talking-to-enemy.speaker: Pirate
dealing-with-the-cannon-talking-to-enemy.text: I'll have ye guts fer garters!

dealing-with-the-cannon-talking-to-enemy.speaker: Pirate
dealing-with-the-cannon-talking-to-enemy.text: Arr! Run him through sez I!

dealing-with-the-cannon-trying-to-plunde.text: I don't have time to search that.

dealing-with-the-cannon-using-a-rope-swi.text: The rope falls off the mast! Clearly your knots are sub-sailor standard.
You fall in the water with a splash!
You have to swim across; which puts a considerable drain on your energy.

dealing-with-the-cannon-using-fuse-on-th.text: You attach the fuse to the barrel.
You are a little too close. Try lighting the end of the fuse.
The fuse refuses to light. Try again.
You cannot get the flame close enough to the fuse to use that to light it.

dealing-with-the-cannon-the-fuse-is-lit.text: ...and destroy the barrel and the cannon.
(The barrel blows up, taking out the cannon in the process.)

sort-out-the-leaks.player: Arr! I've blown their cannon to smithereens Cap'n!

sort-out-the-leaks.speaker: Bill Teach
sort-out-the-leaks.text: Yer not a pirate yet [lad/lass], so stop talkin' like that!

sort-out-the-leaks.speaker: Bill Teach
sort-out-the-leaks.text: Well, ye've sorted out their cannon, but we're takin' on water.

sort-out-the-leaks.speaker: Bill Teach
sort-out-the-leaks.text: Go below deck and sort out the leaks.

sort-out-the-leaks.player: Will smearing swamp paste on the holes do?

sort-out-the-leaks.speaker: Bill Teach
sort-out-the-leaks.text: No [lad/lass], these holes were made by cannon fire.

sort-out-the-leaks.speaker: Bill Teach
sort-out-the-leaks.text: Ye'll need to get some planks from the repair locker and tack them in place. Then ye smear swamp paste over the planks to seal the hole.

sort-out-the-leaks.player: Arr! I'll have this ship ship-shape in no time! Arr!

sort-out-the-leaks.speaker: Bill Teach
sort-out-the-leaks.text: Wait 'till we make landfall before ye start actin' like a pirate!

sort-out-the-leaks-talking-to-bill-teach.player: Errr...I may well have been caught up in the whole 'pirate' thing, and I can't seem to remember what I need to do now...

sort-out-the-leaks-talking-to-bill-teach.speaker: Bill Teach
sort-out-the-leaks-talking-to-bill-teach.text: Ye'll need to get some planks from the repair locker and tack them in place. Then ye smear swamp paste over the planks to seal the hole.

sort-out-the-leaks-talking-to-bill-teach.player: Arr! I be rememberin' now Cap'n!

sort-out-the-leaks-talking-to-bill-teach.speaker: Bill Teach
sort-out-the-leaks-talking-to-bill-teach.text: This is what I get when I ask random strangers for help...

sort-out-the-leaks-returning-to-battle-a.speaker: Bill Teach
sort-out-the-leaks-returning-to-battle-a.text: Looks like they haven't been back to port to get that cannon fixed, which is lucky.

sort-out-the-leaks-returning-to-battle-a.speaker: Bill Teach
sort-out-the-leaks-returning-to-battle-a.text: Get below and fix the holes in the hull pronto, or we'll sink before they have a chance te kill us!
You need 2 repair planks to repair this hole.
You need 10 tacks to repair this hole.
You need a Hammer to repair this hole.

sort-out-the-leaks-planking-up-a-hole.text: You nail the Planks over the the hole!

sort-out-the-leaks-planking-up-a-hole-tr.text: You need Swamp Paste to waterproof this hole.

sort-out-the-leaks-patching-up-a-hole.text: You smear the Swamp Paste over the hole!

sort-out-the-leaks-after-all-the-holes-h.speaker: Bill Teach
sort-out-the-leaks-after-all-the-holes-h.text: Why not pay them a visit and go plunder their hold?

sort-out-the-leaks-after-all-the-holes-h.player: Arr! I'll plunder their booty and no mistake!

sort-out-the-leaks-after-all-the-holes-h.speaker: Bill Teach
sort-out-the-leaks-after-all-the-holes-h.text: Come back here and drop it in the chest in the hold.

sort-out-the-leaks-after-all-the-holes-h.player: Aye aye Cap'n! One plunderin' comin' right up!

sort-out-the-leaks-after-all-the-holes-h.speaker: Bill Teach
sort-out-the-leaks-after-all-the-holes-h.text: I've been a pirate all me life and I've never heard anyone keep harpin' on like that!

time-to-plunder-talking-to-bill-teach-be.player: So...how many loads of plunder did you want me to get?

time-to-plunder-talking-to-bill-teach-be.speaker: Bill Teach
time-to-plunder-talking-to-bill-teach-be.text: Ten! Can't ye count that high?

time-to-plunder-talking-to-bill-teach-be.player: What happens if I take all the plunder I find and there is less than ten loads?

time-to-plunder-talking-to-bill-teach-be.speaker: Bill Teach
time-to-plunder-talking-to-bill-teach-be.text: Then ye wait for the pirates to stash some more in the hold. Since they are under attack they'll be dumpin' their gold and stuff in there every chance they get.

time-to-plunder-talking-to-bill-teach-be.speaker: Bill Teach
time-to-plunder-talking-to-bill-teach-be.text: Just give it a minute and head back!

time-to-plunder-talking-to-bill-teach-be.player: Arr! I'll keep plunderin' till the hold be full of booty!

time-to-plunder-talking-to-bill-teach-be.speaker: Bill Teach
time-to-plunder-talking-to-bill-teach-be.text: Yer not making any friends here [lad/lass], just go and do it.

time-to-plunder-returning-to-plunder-fro.speaker: Bill Teach
time-to-plunder-returning-to-plunder-fro.text: When yer quite done runnin' away lad ye've got a load of plunder to be grabbin'!

time-to-plunder-plundering-the-chest.text: If the player has recently plundered the chest:

steps.text: This chest has been recently plundered.

time-to-plunder-looting-the-crate.text: If the player has recently looted the crate:

steps.text: This crate has been recently looted.

time-to-plunder-looting-the-crate.text: (The player finds two loads of plunder.)

time-to-plunder-ransacking-the-barrel.text: If the player has recently ransacked the barrel:

steps.text: This barrel has been recently ransacked.

time-to-plunder-ransacking-the-barrel.text: (The player finds one load of plunder.)

time-to-plunder-storing-the-loot-in-the-.text: If the player has no plunder to store

steps.text: You have plunder to deposit.

time-to-plunder-storing-the-loot-in-the-.text: You deposit [X] loads of plunder in the chest.
You deposit as much plunder as you can.

time-to-plunder-counting-the-plunder-in-.text: If the storage is filled with 10 plunder

steps.text: This chest is full of plunder.

time-to-plunder-counting-the-plunder-in-.text: This chest has [X] loads of plunder inside.
I seem to have taken all the plunder.

fixing-up-the-cannon.speaker: Bill Teach
fixing-up-the-cannon.text: I warn ye, [lad/lass], if the first word out of yer mouth is 'Arr' I'll be wearing yer spleen as a novelty hat before ye reach the second 'r'!

fixing-up-the-cannon.speaker: Bill Teach
fixing-up-the-cannon.text: I should have seen that comin'

fixing-up-the-cannon.player: Cap'n! I've put ten loads of plunder in the chest, in the hold!

fixing-up-the-cannon.text: If the player has extra plunder on them:

steps.player: I even had some left over!

steps.speaker: Bill Teach
steps.text: Let me see that.

steps.player: Can I have those back?

steps.speaker: Bill Teach
steps.text: Have what back?

steps.player: Nothing...

fixing-up-the-cannon.speaker: Bill Teach
fixing-up-the-cannon.text: Not yet! Let's give em a blast with the cannon before we leave!

fixing-up-the-cannon.speaker: Bill Teach
fixing-up-the-cannon.text: Alright [lad/lass], try and stay with me on this one.

fixing-up-the-cannon.speaker: Bill Teach
fixing-up-the-cannon.text: See, there is a secret technique for making things that be broken right again.

fixing-up-the-cannon.player: How do I repair the cannon?

fixing-up-the-cannon.speaker: Bill Teach
fixing-up-the-cannon.text: Ye need to remove the old barrel, then replace it with a new one from the gun locker downstairs.

fixing-up-the-cannon.speaker: Bill Teach
fixing-up-the-cannon.text: I don't want to overload ye with too many details right now. Come tell me when the cannon is ready again.

fixing-up-the-cannon-talking-to-bill-tea.speaker: Bill Teach
fixing-up-the-cannon-talking-to-bill-tea.text: If ye know what is good for ye, yer off to fix the cannon!

fixing-up-the-cannon-talking-to-bill-tea.player: How was I going to do that again?

fixing-up-the-cannon-talking-to-bill-tea.speaker: Bill Teach
fixing-up-the-cannon-talking-to-bill-tea.text: By replacing the broken barrel with a new one! Hop to it [lad/lass], the salt air is clearly eatin' into yer brains!

fixing-up-the-cannon-returning-to-fix-th.speaker: Bill Teach
fixing-up-the-cannon-returning-to-fix-th.text: Have ye sorted out the cannon yet?

fixing-up-the-cannon-taking-a-new-barrel.text: You don't need [a Ramrod/a cannon ball/a canister/any Fuse] right now.

fixing-up-the-cannon-using-a-new-barrel-.text: You attach the new barrel to the cannon.

fixing-up-the-cannon-talking-to-bill-tea.speaker: Bill Teach
fixing-up-the-cannon-talking-to-bill-tea.text: Have ye fixed the cannon yet, yes or no.

fixing-up-the-cannon-talking-to-bill-tea.speaker: Bill Teach
fixing-up-the-cannon-talking-to-bill-tea.text: Now ye can give those pirates a good shot across their bows.

fixing-up-the-cannon-talking-to-bill-tea.speaker: Bill Teach
fixing-up-the-cannon-talking-to-bill-tea.text: Ye'll need to load the cannon, and if ye get it wrong the barrel will blow, and ye'll need to start again.

fixing-up-the-cannon-talking-to-bill-tea.speaker: Bill Teach
fixing-up-the-cannon-talking-to-bill-tea.text: First, ye take some powder from the powder keg.

fixing-up-the-cannon-talking-to-bill-tea.speaker: Bill Teach
fixing-up-the-cannon-talking-to-bill-tea.text: Then ye use a ramrod from the gun locker on the powder to tamp the charge.

fixing-up-the-cannon-talking-to-bill-tea.speaker: Bill Teach
fixing-up-the-cannon-talking-to-bill-tea.text: Then ye use a canister round on the cannon.

fixing-up-the-cannon-talking-to-bill-tea.speaker: Bill Teach
fixing-up-the-cannon-talking-to-bill-tea.text: Finally ye use some fuse on the cannon, and light it like ye did the fuse on the barrel earlier.

fixing-up-the-cannon-talking-to-bill-tea.speaker: Bill Teach
fixing-up-the-cannon-talking-to-bill-tea.text: Then, ye'll need to use the ramrod on the cannon to clean it out for the next shot.

fixing-up-the-cannon-talking-to-bill-tea.player: Yes, but if I forget I'll come and ask you.

fixing-up-the-cannon-talking-to-bill-tea.speaker: Bill Teach
fixing-up-the-cannon-talking-to-bill-tea.text: And te think this was all I could get te help...

talking-to-bill-teach-again-before-firin.speaker: Bill Teach
talking-to-bill-teach-again-before-firin.text: I can guess from the lack of an explosion that ye haven't fired the cannon yet, correct?

talking-to-bill-teach-again-before-firin.speaker: Bill Teach
talking-to-bill-teach-again-before-firin.text: And I'll bet ye want a quick recap of how to do it, correct?

talking-to-bill-teach-again-before-firin.player: That would help to be honest.

talking-to-bill-teach-again-before-firin.speaker: Bill Teach
talking-to-bill-teach-again-before-firin.text: Ye'll need to load the cannon, and if ye get it wrong the barrel will blow, and ye'll need to start again.

talking-to-bill-teach-again-before-firin.speaker: Bill Teach
talking-to-bill-teach-again-before-firin.text: First, ye take some powder from the powder keg.

talking-to-bill-teach-again-before-firin.speaker: Bill Teach
talking-to-bill-teach-again-before-firin.text: Then ye use a ramrod from the gun locker on the powder to tamp the charge.

talking-to-bill-teach-again-before-firin.speaker: Bill Teach
talking-to-bill-teach-again-before-firin.text: Then ye use a canister round on the cannon.

talking-to-bill-teach-again-before-firin.speaker: Bill Teach
talking-to-bill-teach-again-before-firin.text: Finally ye use some fuse on the cannon, and light it like ye did the fuse on the barrel earlier.

talking-to-bill-teach-again-before-firin.speaker: Bill Teach
talking-to-bill-teach-again-before-firin.text: Then, ye'll need to use the ramrod on the cannon to clean it out for the next shot.

talking-to-bill-teach-again-before-firin.speaker: Bill Teach
talking-to-bill-teach-again-before-firin.text: Ye got all that this time?

talking-to-bill-teach-again-before-firin.speaker: Bill Teach
talking-to-bill-teach-again-before-firin.text: Yer still not a pirate, so cut that out!

talking-to-bill-teach-again-before-firin.speaker: Bill Teach
talking-to-bill-teach-again-before-firin.text: We were on the home stretch lad why did we turn back?

talking-to-bill-teach-again-before-firin.speaker: Bill Teach
talking-to-bill-teach-again-before-firin.text: Never mind, just go shoot the pirates and let's press on.

sinking-the-enemy-ship.player: Well, that seems to have showed them Cap'n!

sinking-the-enemy-ship.speaker: Bill Teach
sinking-the-enemy-ship.text: Great! This ordeal will soon be over!

sinking-the-enemy-ship.player: Aye Cap'n, we'll beat these pirates yet!

sinking-the-enemy-ship.speaker: Bill Teach
sinking-the-enemy-ship.text: Now [lad/lass], we'll send them to the bottom of the sea.

sinking-the-enemy-ship.speaker: Bill Teach
sinking-the-enemy-ship.text: Well, ye'll shoot holes in their hull with the cannon.

sinking-the-enemy-ship.speaker: Bill Teach
sinking-the-enemy-ship.text: Essentially ye do what ye just did, but use a cannonball from the gun locker in the hold instead of the canister rounds.

sinking-the-enemy-ship.player: Arr! I'll sink them scurvy dogs!

sinking-the-enemy-ship.speaker: Bill Teach
sinking-the-enemy-ship.text: Give it three tries and see if they sink, that many holes should do it.

sinking-the-enemy-ship-talking-to-bill-t.player: Cap'n, I know I need to load and fire the cannon at the enemy ship...
and I know I do this by adding powder to the cannon, tamping the charge with a ramrod, adding a cannonball, adding some fuse and then lighting it...
And I also remembered your warning about cleaning the barrel after every shot to avoid the cannon exploding...
But I've forgotten how many times I'm supposed to shoot the enemy ship...

sinking-the-enemy-ship-talking-to-bill-t.speaker: Bill Teach
sinking-the-enemy-ship-talking-to-bill-t.text: Three! Three times [lad/lass]! Three! One more than two, one less than four! Got it!

sinking-the-enemy-ship-talking-to-bill-t.player: There is no need to shout...

sinking-the-enemy-ship-returning-to-sink.speaker: Bill Teach
sinking-the-enemy-ship-returning-to-sink.text: Were almost there! Just hole their hull and we'll be able to make it past. Get to it!

steps.text: You put a hole in the hull!

steps.text: You fail to damage the hull.

sinking-the-enemy-ship-shooting-at-the-h.text: You shoot the cannon ball at the enemy ship!
You put another hole in the hull!

end-of-quest-cutscene.speaker: Bill Teach
end-of-quest-cutscene.text: Ye've done it [lad/lass]! They're sunk now!

end-of-quest-cutscene.speaker: Bill Teach
end-of-quest-cutscene.text: Let's head to the island!

end-of-quest-cutscene.speaker: Mama
end-of-quest-cutscene.text: Bill? You look like you've been to Davey Jones' locker and back.

end-of-quest-cutscene.speaker: Bill Teach
end-of-quest-cutscene.text: Oh, Miss La'Fiette, if only I were that lucky.

end-of-quest-cutscene.speaker: Bill Teach
end-of-quest-cutscene.text: My crew deserted and I was stuck with an adventurer mannin' me ship.

end-of-quest-cutscene.speaker: Bill Teach
end-of-quest-cutscene.text: [He/She] was as piratical as a bunch of Dwellberries...

end-of-quest-cutscene.player: I am still here you know...

end-of-quest-cutscene.speaker: Bill Teach
end-of-quest-cutscene.text: Aye [lad/lass], I remember.

end-of-quest-cutscene.speaker: Mama
end-of-quest-cutscene.text: I'll leave you two alone.

end-of-quest-cutscene.speaker: Bill Teach
end-of-quest-cutscene.text: All right...

end-of-quest-cutscene.speaker: Bill Teach
end-of-quest-cutscene.text: Ok [player name], yer now a pirate, but...

end-of-quest-cutscene.speaker: Bill Teach
end-of-quest-cutscene.text: BUT ye can't just go around talking like some pirate in a fancy play.

end-of-quest-cutscene.speaker: Bill Teach
end-of-quest-cutscene.text: No self-respectin' pirate says 'Arr' that much!

end-of-quest-cutscene.speaker: Bill Teach
end-of-quest-cutscene.text: Well, except for Fancy Dan, but that be another story.

end-of-quest-cutscene.speaker: Bill Teach
end-of-quest-cutscene.text: Here, have this book. It'll learn ye how to be a pirate.

end-of-quest-cutscene.speaker: Bill Teach
end-of-quest-cutscene.text: Or at least learn ye te talk proper like one.

end-of-quest-cutscene.player: So all I have to do is read this book and I'm a pirate?

end-of-quest-cutscene.speaker: Bill Teach
end-of-quest-cutscene.text: Aye...that be all ye need te do.

end-of-quest-cutscene.speaker: Bill Teach
end-of-quest-cutscene.text: Ye'll need that book if ye want te trade with some of the pirates round here.

end-of-quest-cutscene.speaker: Bill Teach
end-of-quest-cutscene.text: Outsiders tend not te understand them if ye catch me drift.

end-of-quest-cutscene.speaker: Bill Teach
end-of-quest-cutscene.text: Anyway, I'd have been shark bait without ye.

end-of-quest-cutscene.speaker: Bill Teach
end-of-quest-cutscene.text: If ye get a moment come see me fer yer share of the loot.

end-of-quest-cutscene.speaker: Bill Teach
end-of-quest-cutscene.text: I'm sure as soon as ye stop yellin' 'Arr!' ye'll make a great pirate.

end-of-quest-cutscene.speaker: Bill Teach
end-of-quest-cutscene.text: Thanks [player name]. If ye need a lift back, just come see me.
Congratulations! Quest complete!

end-of-quest-cutscene-claiming-the-loot-.player: Can I have that gold now?
